preconditions.description: The dimensions of the table must be between 1 and 100.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in output.split('\n'))
postconditions.description: Each row of the output must have exactly m characters.
The output must contain exactly n rows.
All characters in the output must be uppercase Latin letters.
Each color used in the output must appear at least once.

postconditions.expression: all((output[i][j] == output[i+1][j] and output[i][j] == output[i][j+1]) or (output[i][j] != output[i+1][j] and output[i][j] != output[i][j+1]) for i in range(n-1) for j in range(m-1))
postconditions.description: Each connected region of the table must form a square.

postconditions.expression: output == min([generate_coloring(n, m) for _ in range(100)], key=lambda x: x.replace('\n', ''))
postconditions.description: The output must be the lexicographically minimum coloring of the table that meets the described conditions.
